meta.name: Stingray Classica
meta.description:
Discover breathtaking classical music concerts, operas, and ballets from some of the grandest venues around the world.

Shows: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko, Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto, Daniel Harding & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia, Konstantin Khvatynets & Boris Berezovsky, Quatuor Ebène
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
